ProcessFaq.label: How we work
ProcessFaq.intro: We make our method clear: understand the operational problem, choose the right level of technology, and ship systems people can actually adopt.

0.title: Clarify the real business constraint
0.description: We start from the operational bottleneck, not from a fashionable tool. The first question is always what needs to become faster, more accurate, more scalable, or easier to use.

1.title: Select the minimum viable architecture
1.description: Sometimes that means a lightweight Next.js app. Sometimes it means a computer-vision pipeline, background workers, containers, and inference services. We choose the smallest correct system.

2.title: Connect models, interfaces, and data flows
2.description: We treat the model, the API, the storage layer, and the product surface as one engineering problem, so the output is useful in the hands of real teams.

3.title: Iterate toward production readiness
3.description: After the first version works, we improve observability, reliability, deployment repeatability, and usability so the project can survive beyond the demo stage.

about.p1: I embraced computer science for the sense of freedom it gives. The freedom to act, to create, to change and, when possible, to innovate.
about.p2: I graduated from Sapienza University of Rome, completing both my bachelor's and master's degrees with top marks. I am a dynamic person, sometimes contradictory, constantly evolving. I never stand still: my creative restlessness and the drive to challenge myself and push my limits are what keep me working for hours on a project I consider “mine.”
about.p3: After years of working while studying and gaining professional experience in different companies, I decided to give myself a different opportunity: to build something truly my own. I founded a startup, putting my experience, years of study and personal sacrifices at the service of my own ideas and vision. I design software architectures and develop full-stack solutions, integrating AI systems built to solve real-world problems.
about.p4: I am a positive, curious and meticulous person. I constantly question myself. I am always looking for new paths to explore, new ways to grow, and new projects worth dedicating myself to.

header.quote: "For the roads, they go on without end."

about.p1: Since the dawn of time, humanity has lived in God's shadow, seeking Him and envying His greatest privilege: the capacity to create. Condemned to finitude, man invented art to emulate that miracle, shaping stories and figures to feel like the master of a destiny.
about.p2: However, only computer science allows us to transcend the stasis of the canvas. Programming is the ultimate creative act, where logic becomes matter and thought becomes action. The thirst for omnipotence is quenched in every algorithm that works, in every system that springs to life beneath our fingers. If art imitates life, computer science simulates it. And in that microcosm of rules and variables, man finally touches the divine illusion of having created life itself.
about.p3: Perhaps one day the spell will break, for I have realized that giving life to one’s own creatures consumes the soul. Yet, it is a destiny I cannot evade. Every morning, facing the glow of the screen, I listen to that whisper which overpowers all reason: it is not a choice, it is a necessity. I must continue playing God until the voice of sleep screams louder than the voice of programming.

Mirror.tagline: ISTAT open data, accessible and queryable for everyone
Mirror.description: Mirror is a Data Ops and exploration platform built on Italy's ISTAT open data ecosystem. It bridges the gap between complex statistical infrastructure and the analysts, developers, journalists, and citizens who need it.
Mirror.meta_description: Mirror transforms Italy's fragmented ISTAT statistical databases into a navigable, API-ready platform. REST documentation, Postman collections, Dataset Browser, and AI-powered natural language queries over thousands of public datasets.
Mirror.supporting: The real opportunity is not another statistics portal. Mirror should own the semantic space around ISTAT data access — serving developers who need documented REST APIs, analysts who need a Dataset Browser, and citizens who want direct answers.
Mirror.phase1_desc: Developer-facing documentation hub: REST API references, Postman collections, and integration guides
Mirror.phase2_desc: User-facing web app with Dataset Browser, interactive visualizations, and AI-powered natural language queries
Mirror.problem_title: ISTAT data is public. Using it is not.
Mirror.problem_desc: Italy's National Institute of Statistics publishes vast volumes of open data under Creative Commons licenses. But the official portals — IstatData, I.Stat, LOD-Istat — are designed for specialists. Complex pivot systems, SDMX formats, and multidimensional extraction interfaces create a substantial barrier for anyone without deep statistical expertise.

problem_items.0: Complex selection interfaces requiring manual parameter configuration before any data is visible
problem_items.1: Parameter-heavy URLs that are difficult to navigate, share, or bookmark for repeated use
problem_items.2: No direct answers to specific queries — users must construct their own extraction logic
problem_items.3: Poor mobile UX and high bounce rate among non-specialist users seeking immediate answers

Mirror.gap_title: Mirror inserts a Data Ops layer
Mirror.gap_desc: By sitting between ISTAT's infrastructure and end users, Mirror converts statistical fragmentation into accessible knowledge — giving developers documented REST APIs and Postman collections, analysts an intuitive Dataset Browser, and everyone else an AI-powered natural language interface.

visualize.title: Data Visualization
visualize.desc: Charts, tables, and interactive dashboards that turn raw statistical tables into understandable trend views at a glance.

ai.desc: AI-powered system that interprets plain-language questions — such as 'unemployment in northern Italy 2024' — and retrieves the relevant ISTAT data automatically.

explain.desc: AI-generated explanatory text alongside each dataset, turning raw numbers into semantically rich, high-value pages with immediate informational value.

Mirror.faq_subtitle: Answers for developers, analysts, data journalists, and anyone navigating Italy's public statistical data.

0.question: What is ISTAT data and why is it hard to access?
0.answer: ISTAT (Istituto Nazionale di Statistica) is Italy's primary source of public statistical data — covering demographics, labor, trade, agriculture, and more — published under open licenses. The challenge is that the official portals are built for specialists: multidimensional pivot tables, SDMX extraction formats, and parameter-heavy URLs that require significant expertise to navigate, producing a high bounce rate among non-expert users.

1.question: What does Mirror's Phase 1 developer documentation include?
1.answer: Phase 1 builds a complete developer resource hub: full REST API endpoint references for ISTAT web services, downloadable Postman collections with preconfigured environments for rapid endpoint testing, and step-by-step integration guides covering workflows like bulk data extraction and SDMX integration in Python, R, and JavaScript.

2.question: How does Mirror's natural language query system work?
2.answer: Mirror's AI interprets plain-language questions — such as 'What is the unemployment rate in northern Italy for 2024?' — translates them into structured queries against the ISTAT dataset catalog, and returns the relevant figures alongside contextual explanations that help users understand the meaning behind the numbers.

3.question: Who is Mirror built for?
3.answer: Mirror serves two core audiences: developers and data engineers who need well-documented REST APIs, testing environments, and integration guides for ISTAT data; and analysts, journalists, researchers, and general users who want to explore public statistical data without specialist knowledge or complex technical configuration.

footer.title: Transforming statistical fragmentation into usable knowledge
footer.desc: Mirror's founding promise — turning Italy's complex ISTAT data infrastructure into accessible insights — fulfilled for developers, analysts, and everyone in between.
